_finding: Owner, 25.11: the Demo Agent finds a stock by searching the market, as anyone would, and Proof of Stock tells the original from the rest. The search example is where a list of look-alikes turns into one address to buy: it must buy only the one the issuer lists, ask about every candidate, stop when any answer is missing, and never show a stranger's link.

mutations.name: a token the issuer does not list is picked
mutations.expect: FAIL the pick is the one the issuer lists

mutations.name: a batch that could not be read does not stop the buy
mutations.expect: FAIL the batch check unreadable: exit 3, no quote

mutations.name: a stranger's link is shown as written
mutations.expect: FAIL a link or a domain is cut out

mutations.name: every token in the pools found is a candidate, the quote token included
mutations.expect: FAIL candidates are the tokens carrying the ticker or the company

mutations.name: a market search that failed reads as an empty market
mutations.find: if (found == null) return stop(3, 'unavailable', 'The market search could not be read, so I do not buy.')
mutations.expect: FAIL the market search unreadable: exit 3, no quote
